title: Recap: official register for treaties and courts

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know the official register from C1 Unit 8. A treaty becomes part of Hungarian law by promulgation (*kihirdetés*), in a law or in a government decree (*törvényben vagy kormányrendeletben*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The Fundamental Law says that Hungary ensures harmony between international law and Hungarian law (*összhang*). The Constitutional Court can examine whether a law conflicts with an international treaty.
